definition.title: Compare people and things
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

blocks.text: Use 比 before the comparison point. 跟…一样 says equal on the named quality; 没有…那么… says one side does not reach the other. 最 selects the highest degree within an understood comparison group. 更 emphasizes a higher degree. A quantity after the adjective measures the difference, rather than either total.

examples.meaning: He is older than I am.
He is the same age as I am.

examples.text: 这本书没有那本书那么好。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū méiyǒu nà běn shū nàme hǎo 。
examples.meaning: This book is not as good as that one.
He is even busier than me.

examples.pinyin: tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì 。
examples.meaning: He is two years older than me.
